verdict.rationale: gstack is a pack of agent skills and workflows, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. The pack shows no mechanism for users to define rules that fire actions on events. The closest items are adjacent built-in behaviors, none of which is a user-authored event-to-action rule: speech-to-text invocation aliases, the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE toggle, automatic end-of-session learnings logging, and agent-written per-host notes injected into prompts.
